full_judgment:
This Rule arises out of an application under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure and is directed against the judgment and decree dated 11-8-90 passed by Mr. Shahiduzzaman, Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Chittagong in Other Appeal No. 447 of 1985, dismissing the appeal and affirming the judgment and decree dated 8-7-85 passed by Mr. Mahabubur Rahman, Subordinate Judge, First Court, Chittagong, dismissing Other Suit No. 3 of 1983 

 5. The learned subordinate Judge, First Court, Chittagong by the judgment and decree dated 8-7-85 dismissed the suit. 

 6. The plaintiff being aggrieved by the judgment and decree passed in the suit preferred an appeal being Other Appeal No. 447 of 1985 in the Court of District Judge. 

 7. The learned Additional District Judge, Second Court, Chittagong heard the appeal and by the judgment and decree dated 11-8-90 dismissed the appeal and affirmed the judgment and decree passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, First Court, Chittagong. 

 8. Against the said judgment and decree the plaintiff as petitioner moved this Court in Civil Revisional application under section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure and obtained this Rule.
